enonce.texte: Match the following compliance and data privacy terms with their correct definitions.

questions.texte: Match the terms with their definitions.

sousQuestions.reponse: General Data Protection Regulation - EU regulation for data protection and privacy.
Adhering to laws, regulations, and internal policies.
An individual whose personal data is being collected or processed.
An incident where personal data is accessed, disclosed, or lost without authorization.
Permission given by a data subject for their data to be processed.

enonce.texte: Read each scenario and determine whether the described action is compliant or non-compliant with GDPR, and explain why.

questions.texte: A company collects user email addresses to send marketing emails. Users can opt-out at any time via a link in the email.
questions.reponse: Compliant. Users have given consent and have the option to withdraw it, which meets GDPR requirements.

questions.texte: A company stores customer data indefinitely without a clear retention policy.
questions.reponse: Non-compliant. GDPR requires organizations to have a data retention policy and not keep data longer than necessary.

questions.texte: A company shares user data with a third-party vendor without informing users or obtaining their consent.
questions.reponse: Non-compliant. GDPR requires explicit consent for data sharing with third parties, and users must be informed.

enonce.texte:
You are the Product Manager for a mobile application that collects user data for analytics and personalized recommendations. Write a privacy notice for your app that includes:

  • What data is collected.
  • Why the data is collected.
  • How the data is used.
  • User rights (access, correction, deletion).
  • Contact information for privacy inquiries.

questions.texte: Write the privacy notice.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse : 

**Privacy Notice for [App Name]**

**1. Data We Collect**
We collect the following types of data:
- Personal information: email address, name, and device ID.
- Usage data: app interactions, features used, and session duration.

**2. Why We Collect Data**
We collect this data to improve your experience, provide personalized recommendations, and analyze app performance.

**3. How We Use Data**
Your data is used for analytics, personalization, and communication regarding updates or offers.

**4. Your Rights**
You have the right to access, correct, or delete your data at any time. You may also withdraw consent for data processing.

**5. Contact Us**
For privacy-related questions, contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@example.com.

enonce.texte: Match the GDPR data protection principle with its description.

questions.texte: Lawfulness, Fairness, and Transparency
questions.reponse: Data must be processed legally, fairly, and in a transparent manner.

questions.texte: Purpose Limitation
questions.reponse: Data must be collected for specified, explicit, and legitimate purposes and not used for other purposes.

questions.texte: Data Minimization
questions.reponse: Only data that is necessary for the purpose should be collected.

questions.texte: Storage Limitation
questions.reponse: Data must not be kept for longer than necessary.

questions.texte: Integrity and Confidentiality
questions.reponse: Data must be processed in a way that ensures security, including protection against unauthorized access.

enonce.texte:
Your company is implementing a new data privacy policy. You need to communicate this to two different audiences:

  • Audience A: The engineering team (technical details, implementation steps).
  • Audience B: Non-technical stakeholders (overview, benefits, timeline).

Write a brief communication for each audience.

questions.texte: Write the communication for the engineering team.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse : 

**Subject: New Data Privacy Policy - Implementation Details**

Hi Engineering Team,

We are implementing a new data privacy policy to ensure compliance with GDPR. The key changes are:

1. **Data Encryption:** All user data must be encrypted at rest and in transit.
2. **Logging:** We need to implement logging for all data access requests.
3. **Data Deletion:** A script must be created to handle user deletion requests (right to be forgotten).

Implementation Timeline: The changes must be completed by the end of the quarter. Please update your respective modules accordingly.

questions.texte: Write the communication for non-technical stakeholders.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse : 

**Subject: New Data Privacy Policy - Overview**

Dear Stakeholders,

We are pleased to announce the implementation of our new data privacy policy. This initiative ensures compliance with GDPR and strengthens our commitment to protecting user data.

**Key Benefits:**
- Enhanced user trust and confidence.
- Reduced risk of data breaches and fines.
- Improved data management practices.

**Timeline:** The policy will be fully implemented by the end of the quarter. We will keep you updated on progress.

We appreciate your support in this important initiative.

enonce.texte:
Your company experienced a data breach. The breach involved unauthorized access to user names, email addresses, and hashed passwords. You need to notify the relevant authorities (as required by GDPR) and affected users.

Write:

  1. A notification to the data protection authority (DPA) describing the breach.
  2. A customer notification email informing users of the breach and what they should do.

questions.texte: Write the notification to the Data Protection Authority.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse : 

**Data Breach Notification - [Company Name]**

**Date:** June 10, 2026

**Description of Incident:**
On June 8, 2026, at 2:30 PM GMT, an unauthorized party gained access to our database containing user information. The breach was discovered on June 9, 2026, at 9:00 AM GMT.

**Data Involved:**
- Names
- Email addresses
- Hashed passwords (encrypted)

**Number of Affected Users:** Approximately 1,000 users.

**Actions Taken:**
- The database has been secured.
- All affected passwords have been reset.
- We are implementing additional security measures to prevent recurrence.

**Contact:** For further information, please contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@company.com.

questions.texte: Write the customer notification email.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse : 

**Subject: Important Notice Regarding Your Account**

Dear [User],

We are writing to inform you of a recent data security incident that may have affected your account.

**What Happened:**
On June 8, 2026, we discovered that an unauthorized party had accessed our database. This incident involved your name, email address, and password (encrypted).

**What We Are Doing:**
- We have secured the database and taken steps to prevent future incidents.
- All passwords have been reset for security reasons.

**What You Should Do:**
- Log in to your account and set a new, strong password.
- Enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) for added security.
- Monitor your accounts for any suspicious activity.

We apologize for any inconvenience. Your privacy and security are our top priorities.

For any questions, please contact our support team.

enonce.texte: You are auditing a software application for GDPR compliance. Check off the items that are required for compliance. Identify any missing requirements.

questions.texte: The application collects user data with explicit consent.
questions.reponse: Required.

questions.texte: Users can request a copy of their data.
questions.reponse: Required.

questions.texte: Users can delete their account and data.
questions.reponse: Required.

questions.texte: Data is stored indefinitely for analytics purposes.
questions.reponse: Not compliant. Data must be stored only for as long as necessary.

questions.texte: All data is stored in a secure location with access controls.
questions.reponse: Required.

enonce.texte:
A stakeholder asks: 'Why do we need to invest so much time and money in GDPR compliance? It seems like a burden on our engineering team.'

Write a response that explains the importance of GDPR compliance and addresses the stakeholder's concerns.

questions.texte: Write your response to the stakeholder.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse : 

'Thank you for raising this important concern. GDPR compliance is not just a legal obligation; it is an investment in trust and security. Non-compliance can result in fines of up to 4% of annual turnover, but more importantly, it can damage our reputation and user trust. By implementing GDPR compliance, we:

- **Protect user data** and reduce the risk of breaches.
- **Build trust** with our users, which is a competitive advantage.
- **Streamline data management**, which can actually reduce long-term costs.

While there is an upfront investment, the long-term benefits far outweigh the costs. I'd be happy to discuss how we can prioritize this work to minimize disruption to the engineering team.'
